name.description: Component name in PascalCase or kebab-case (e.g. Switch, ProgressBar, progress-bar).
name.x-prompt: What is the component name? (e.g. Switch, ProgressBar)

items.label: form-controls — buttons, inputs, selects, checkboxes, file-dropzone
data-display — badges, cards, tables, lists, skeletons
feedback — dialogs, toasts, tooltips, spinners, alerts
navigation — tabs, menus, breadcrumbs, command palette

pattern.description: Component pattern. simple-variants = cva + forwardRef (e.g. Button, Badge). simple-no-variants = forwardRef + cn only (e.g. Input). compound = multiple named sub-components (e.g. Card, Table).

items.label: simple-variants — cva variants + forwardRef (e.g. Button, Badge, Skeleton, Avatar)
simple-no-variants — forwardRef + cn, no variants (e.g. Input, Label, Separator)
compound — multiple named sub-components (e.g. Card, Table, Dialog stub)
